## Problem Statement

Let $\epsilon>0$. Does there exist a constant $C_\epsilon$ such that, for all primes $p$, every residue modulo $p$ is the sum of at most $C_\epsilon$ many elements of
$$\{ n^{-1} : 1\leq n\leq p^\epsilon\}$$
where $n^{-1}$ denotes the inverse of $n$ modulo $p$?
